resolution: Follow-up design Q&A on req_3259: confirmed the icosphere eyes already satisfy the eyes-as-own-surface recommendation — a 3D eyeball part is the classic sibling of the eye-quad (same decoupling: eye texture separate from face paint, blink = frame swap on the part's own painted surface), and it upgrades look-at from a UV slide to true eyeball rotation. Advised renaming the parts to eye_l/eye_r per the role-naming contract so the generator and animation tracks key on them.
